page_limit_content.note: 正文（含全部图、表）上限 8 页；仅含参考文献的额外页不计入

evidence.quote: Papers are limited to eight pages, including figures and tables, in the CVPR style. Additional pages containing only cited references are allowed.

references_counted.note: 参考文献不计入 8 页正文；仅参考文献可占额外页

evidence.quote: Additional pages containing only cited references are allowed.

appendix_allowed.note: 由“仅参考文献可占额外页”推断：技术附录须放入补充材料，不进正文计页（官方指南未单列“禁止附录”字样）

evidence.quote: Papers are limited to eight pages, including figures and tables, in the CVPR style. Additional pages containing only cited references are allowed.

paper_size.note: 官方模板以 letterpaper 载入；sty 按 8.5x11in IEEE Proceedings 设计

evidence.quote: \documentclass[10pt,twocolumn,letterpaper]{article}

columns.note: 官方模板为双栏（twocolumn）；违规单栏会被拒

evidence.quote: \documentclass[10pt,twocolumn,letterpaper]{article}

body_font_size_pt.note: 正文 10-point Times；模板与 sty 均强制 10pt

evidence.quote: Type main text in 10-point Times, single-spaced.
Type main text in 10-point Times, single-spaced.

line_spacing.note: 正文单倍行距，段落不加额外空行

evidence.quote: Type main text in 10-point Times, single-spaced.

text_width_mm.note: 6.875in = 174.625mm 版心总宽（两栏 + 栏间距）

evidence.quote: \setlength{\textwidth}{6.875in}
\setlength{\textheight}{8.875in}

column_gap_mm.note: 0.3125in = 7.9375mm 栏间距（模板正文亦写 5/16 inch = 0.8cm）

evidence.quote: \setlength{\columnsep}{0.3125in}
On all pages, the bottom margin should be $1\frac{1}{8}$ inches (2.86 cm) from the bottom edge of the page for $8.5 \times 11$-inch paper;
The main title (on the first page) should begin 1 inch (2.54 cm) from the top edge of the page.

title_format.note: 标题居中、Times 14-point 粗体、首字母大写规则

evidence.quote: The title should be in Times 14-point, boldface type.

section_numbering.note: 一级标题形如 1. Introduction（Times 12pt 粗体，左对齐）

evidence.quote: (For example, {\large \bf 1. Introduction}) should be Times 12-point boldface, initially capitalized, flush left, with one blank line before and one blank line after.

anonymity.note: 双盲评审；正文/致谢/补充材料均不得泄露身份

evidence.quote: CVPR reviewing is double blind, in that authors do not know the names of the area chairs or reviewers for their papers, and the area chairs/reviewers cannot, beyond a reasonable doubt, infer the names of the authors from the submission and the additional material.

submission_system.note: 自 CVPR 2023 起使用 OpenReview 管理投稿

evidence.quote: CVPR 2025 will be using OpenReview to manage submissions.

page_numbering.value: review version numbered, camera-ready no page numbers
page_numbering.note: 送审版加页码；camera-ready 版不加页码

evidence.quote: The review version should have page numbers, yet the final version submitted as camera ready should not show any page numbers.

supplementary_policy.value: optional supplementary material; may include videos, proofs, additional figures/tables; no extra datasets/improved results
supplementary_policy.note: 补充材料可选、独立提交；不得含额外数据集/改进结果/修正版正文

evidence.quote: Supplementary material may include videos, proofs, additional figures or tables, more detailed analysis of experiments presented in the paper, or a concurrent submission to CVPR or another conference.
Table captions should be above tables, while figure captions should be below figures.
Table captions should be above tables, while figure captions should be below figures.
The captions of the figures and tables should be in 9-point Roman type as in \cref{fig:onecol,fig:short}.

reference_style_hint.note: 参考文献 9-point Times、单倍行距、按数字编号引用

evidence.quote: List and number all bibliographical references in 9-point Times, single-spaced, at the end of your paper.
Use Times 8-point type, single-spaced.

color_policy.value: avoid relying on color alone (color-vision deficiency)
color_policy.note: 图表避免仅靠颜色区分（红色盲/绿色盲）

evidence.quote: If you use color in your plots, please keep in mind that a significant subset of reviewers and readers may have a color vision deficiency; red-green blindness is the most frequent kind.

区分正文页与总页；否则 8 页约束会把参考文献算进去
